notes: Ranks and prices are copied from the Amazon Best Sellers pages linked here. Amazon says those lists are updated frequently.
Each rank is the position on that named list only. Ranks are not combined into one chart.
Sales counts are omitted because these lists do not publish them.
A rank-change arrow is omitted because these lists do not show whether a rank moved up or down.
The price is the price printed on the bestseller list that day, not an average. Live listing prices can differ by size or color and can change after this date.
Walmart, Dick's Sporting Goods, and eBay were reviewed on the same day and not used for these figures. Those pages did not show a numbered rank and a price together for a single sports-gear listing.
